verdict.rationale: HeyGen's developer docs say every endpoint ships with "typed schemas" alongside llms.txt and an MCP server. That is a first-party claim of machine-readable endpoint definitions, but it never names a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec file. A probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on all candidates. This weakens the case without directly contradicting the vague "typed schemas" claim, and llms.txt and the MCP server are adjacent features that earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec URL, evidence of what format the typed schemas take, and hands-on confirmation that a spec can be fetched.
